searchText: This is great work, thanks. You might find this old work interesting. https://github.com/ethereum/evmone/issues/71 thanks for the link, however I wasn't involved in the project above. just sharing Thanks. I should contact the authors. I know this team and have regular calls with them. They are currently working on Stage II so if you have any requests or questions I can forward these or connect you directly. would you be able to get them to join here for discussions? i think that would be really productive! Can you elaborate on this? If state growth isn’t an issue, why would we not reduce storage opcodes to make optimistic rollups cheaper, or increase the gas limit in an attempt to reduce overall fees in the short-term? Is it just the fact that storage is cheaper that makes you not worried about state growth but you are concerned about processing throughput? OpenEthereum has a sunset coming up. I think they should add Nethermind and Besu to their evaluation list for phase 2. I think I'm the loudest proponent of increasing the gas limit here
